title: The Prayer in the Dark
old_p1: Inside the great fish it was dark and very, very quiet. Jonah could not go anywhere at all. So Jonah prayed. Praying is talking to Heavenly Father.
“I cried because of my trouble,” Jonah prayed, “and He heard me.” Jonah remembered the seaweed wrapped around his head, and how very far down he had gone.
old_p2: “When I felt weak, I remembered the Lord,” Jonah said, “and my prayer came to You.” Jonah had run away, but now he turned back to Heavenly Father.
Then Heavenly Father spoke to the fish, and it put Jonah out onto dry land.
No place is too dark or too far for Heavenly Father to hear. Fold your hands tonight and feel how near He is.
p1: Jonah was inside the great fish. It was dark in there. So Jonah prayed. To pray means to talk to Heavenly Father.
Jonah prayed, “I called to You when I was in trouble, and You heard me.” He remembered the deep sea. Seaweed had wrapped around his head.
Jonah had run away from Heavenly Father. Now he was turning back to Him. “When I felt weak,” Jonah said, “I remembered the Lord.”
p2: Jonah said thank you to Heavenly Father. He promised to do what he said he would do. Then Heavenly Father spoke to the fish. The fish put Jonah out onto dry land.
No place is too dark or too far for Heavenly Father to hear you. Tonight you can fold your arms and talk to Him, just like Jonah did.
